comparison.objective: Set two power-rack safety arms to matched safe heights versus tune and retain a damper setting from dynamic stopping behavior.
comparison.physical_skill: Bilateral sliding/notch placement versus recessed tool insertion, fine rotary adjustment, counterholding, locking, and iterative physical testing.
comparison.success_condition: Both arms at 7–8 cm, with penalties for unsafe or high positions, versus two compliant impact cycles meeting energy, stroke, rebound, overload, and drift limits.
comparison.reason: Both involve adjustment, but one tests discrete symmetric height placement while the candidate tests dynamic damping calibration and retained locking.
